question: Which Assamese artist was known as Sudhakantha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhupen Hazarika**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhupen Hazarika** was a renowned Assamese artist, known by the title **Sudhakantha**, which means '**The Nightingale**'.
 
• He was a multifaceted talent, excelling as a singer, composer, and filmmaker, and is celebrated for his contributions to Assamese music and culture.
 
• Hazarika's songs are known for their **deep social messages**, touching upon themes of humanity, communal harmony, and the beauty of Assam.
 
• His work has had a lasting impact on Assamese culture and continues to inspire generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bhupen Hazarika was born on **8th September 1926**, in **Sadiya, Assam**.
 
• He received numerous awards and honors, including the **Padma Bhushan** (**2001**), **Padma Vibhushan** (**2012, posthumously**), and the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** (**1992**).
 
• Hazarika was also a prominent figure in Indian cinema and was instrumental in popularizing Assamese cinema.
 
• He passed away on **5th November 2011**, leaving behind a rich legacy of cultural and musical heritage.
